description: Hand-written questions with gold SQL and expected results, split by difficulty. 'expected_rows' was computed by running the gold SQL against data/sample.db (scripts/make_sample_db.py, seed 42) -- never hand-edited. Ambiguous items expect a clarification, not a result.
name: Text-to-SQL golden set (sample DB)

questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders
questions.question: How many orders are there in total?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers
questions.question: How many customers do we have?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT order_status FROM orders ORDER BY order_status
questions.question: List the distinct order statuses.

questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(review_score) FROM order_reviews
questions.question: What is the average review score?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled'
questions.question: How many orders were canceled?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY n DESC, customer_state ASC LIMIT 5
questions.question: List the top 5 states by number of customers.

questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products
questions.question: How many products are in the catalog?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(price) FROM order_items
questions.question: What is the highest item price?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
questions.question: Which product category has the most orders?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_city FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_id LIMIT 10
questions.question: List the first 10 orders with their customer city.

questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.seller_id, s.seller_city FROM sellers s JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' ORDER BY s.seller_id
questions.question: Which sellers sold items in delivered orders?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(r.review_score) FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP'
questions.question: What is the average review score for orders from customers in SP?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT oi.price, p.product_category_name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY oi.price DESC LIMIT 5
questions.question: List the 5 most expensive items with their product category.

questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY n DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 3
questions.question: Which 3 customers placed the most orders?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, SUM(payment_value) AS total FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total DESC
questions.question: What is the total payment value per payment type?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_city FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' ORDER BY c.customer_city
questions.question: Which cities have customers who placed delivered orders?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(price) FROM order_items
questions.question: What is our total revenue?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC
questions.question: What is the total revenue by product category?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(order_total) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS order_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)
questions.question: What is the average order value?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date
questions.question: How many late deliveries were there?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(order_purchase_timestamp)) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
questions.question: What is the average delivery time in days?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
questions.question: What is the revenue per month in 2017?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
questions.question: Which state has the highest total revenue?

questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(freight_value) FROM order_items
questions.question: What is the average freight value?
